kssu-v0.1.0.description:
# Initial Release!

## Features included:
- All 11 Main-Games supported.
- All 5 Sub-Games as a toggleable option.
- Progression barriers for Dyna Blade, TGCO and Meta Knightmare Ultra
- Many different goal options
- Custom commands in the client
- Universal Tracker support
- Deathlink
- And more!
kssu-v0.1.0.title: Kirby Super Star Ultra v0.1.0

kssu-v0.1.2.description:
## Additions
- Added new checks for completing each main-game, which now includes Gourmet Race, The Great Cave Offensive, Milky Way Wishes, Helper to Hero and The True Arena

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed Milky Way Wishes de-spawning uncollected ability if received by the multiworld
- Dyna Blade now no longer incorrectly sends check for uncompleted stages
- The Big Switches in Dyna Blade no longer disappear if the stage was unlocked beforehand
- Subgames were fixed to only send one check after the game is completed and switching difficulties

**This version is NOT backwards compatible with worlds generated with v0.1.0 or v0.1.1!**
The currently known bugs list has been updated in FAQ, be sure to check that first!

kssu-v0.2.0.description:
## New Additions
- Added Eject Trap & Freeze Trap
- Added an option to enable extra locations for Samurai Kirby & Megaton Punch, for each level of difficulty.

## Changes
- Slightly modified logic for The Arena, which now logically requires at least 1 ability after the 3rd win (and 5 abilities after the 9th win).
- Slightly modified logic for The True Arena, which now logically requires at least 5 abilities after the 3rd win.
- Added checks during item pool generation to prevent unbeatable seeds when certain games are selected as the starting game.
- Adjusted the `/games`, `/ability` and `/planets` commands to take up less space.

## Bug fixes
- **Items that were already collected no longer re-send after resetting or re-connecting, and are now saved in-game.**
- Fixed MWW's ability pause screen, which now accurately displays the abilities that have been received.
- Fixed a bug that inaccurately sent locations when the option "Multiworld" was selected for MWW.
- Changed generation to ensure no impossible seeds are possible when starting with Dyna Blade
- Fixed a bug where losing Round 2 of Gourmet Race after winning Round 1 would send the location for Round 3

## Known Bugs
Please refer to the [FAQ](https://github.com/GhostCappy/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/kssu/docs/FAQ.md) for all currently known bugs. If you have any questions, feel free to ping!

This version is **NOT** backwards compatible with seeds generated before v0.2.0.
kssu-v0.2.0.title: Kirby Super Star Ultra (KSSU) - v0.2.0
